This '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' was stationed aboard [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class]] [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|frigate]] during a [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|Skirmish]] near [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]].

==History==
The droid was present in the ships [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] when Dooku made his escape from the frigate, which was being assaulted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. After being startled by the Count's sudden appearance, he told him his [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|ship]] was ready. The Count boarded and the droid saw him off. As [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the hangar, he saw Dooku leaving aboard his Solar Sailer, and quickly made his way to a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]]. Outside the shuttle were the commander and a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], presumably going to make their escape. Obi-Wan ignited his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Sai cha/Legends|destroyed]] the commander with one stroke before sending the B1's blaster fire back at him. Kenobi started the shuttle, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] boarding shortly after. Kenobi managed to shoot down Dooku, before their ship was hit by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droid]]. Both ships crashed on the surface of Vanqor, which would lead to a [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|mission]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].

==Behind the scenes==
This droid, like all battle droids, was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].
